what: Test expectation contradicts the substantiality gate
scenario_or_breakage: The plan defines two high-severity accepted findings as substantial and says substantial rounds below cap continue, but the proposed test asserts complete after one substantial round
suggested_fix: Revise the test to expect another round or change the gate definition; keep the test fixture aligned with the documented substantiality rule

what: Per-round pre-coder HEAD artifact is not explicitly required
scenario_or_breakage: The loop needs round-N pre and post coder SHAs for numstat, but the current code only writes a run-level pre-review-head on round 1 and the plan only adds post-coder-head
suggested_fix: Require _implement_round_body to write round-${round_num}/pre-coder-head.txt before coder dispatch for every round, then compute numstat against that per-round file

what: Required tests are missing for the absorbed relevant-checks and lint-fix-loop paths
scenario_or_breakage: The goal requires the wrapper to internalize run-relevant-checks-captured.sh and lint-fix-loop.sh, but the listed tests cover round statuses and gates without checking checks pass/skipped, structural failure, redacted-log failure, lint-fix applied, no-changes, failed, or main-agent-required
suggested_fix: Add loop tests that stub run-relevant-checks-captured.sh and lint-fix-loop.sh for every terminal branch and assert STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS, STALL_REASON, and re-check behavior

what: The loop has no specified handling for nonzero or unknown round failures
scenario_or_breakage: run_implement_round can exit nonzero with statuses outside panel-failed/coder-failed/submodule-violation, so the new loop could fall into the success path or emit no final envelope when review-core or validation fails unexpectedly
suggested_fix: Add an explicit branch: any nonzero _implement_round_body exit or unknown REVIEW_AND_FIX_STATUS exits with STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS=stall and a distinct STALL_REASON such as round-failed or review-core-<status>, plus a test for that path
